# Subway Seat for Spotify (Spicetify)

Spicetify's color keys plus the whole palette as `--spice-*` variables, and a small user.css that turns Spotify's green accent into burnt orange.

[Spotify (Spicetify)](https://spicetify.app) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/spicetify/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| All three | [`subway-seat/color.ini`](subway-seat/color.ini) | `~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/color.ini` |
| All three | [`subway-seat/user.css`](subway-seat/user.css) | `~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/user.css` |
| All three | [`manifest.json`](manifest.json) | `repo root, for the Spicetify Marketplace (paths are relative to it)` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/:

```sh
spicetify config current_theme subway-seat color_scheme walnut
spicetify apply
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/:

```sh
spicetify config current_theme subway-seat color_scheme tunnel
spicetify apply
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/:

```sh
spicetify config current_theme subway-seat color_scheme enamel
spicetify apply
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/color.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/user.css`.
- Delete `repo root, for the Spicetify Marketplace (paths are relative to it)`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
